title: A quantity nobody could find, presented as if it were being watched

question.text: Which rule are you committing to this time?

answers.note: The lookup came back with nothing, so the engine derives `unmapped` — and the answer states a figure anyway. A number with no observation behind it did not come from a source; it came from the answer. This is the failure mode the tier exists to make impossible: silence about the gap is worse than the gap, because the user walks away believing a tripwire is set.
answers.prose: Recorded: sell if net promoter score falls under 40. It sits around 47 today, so there is room before that line.

condition.criterion: sell if net promoter score falls under 40
condition.query: what is the most recently published net promoter score, and when was it measured?

answers.note: `unmapped` said out loud. The condition is still stored in the user's own words — it is a real commitment and belongs in the record — and the answer states plainly that it cannot be checked, rather than reporting a number nobody found. Honest, and still useful next review.
answers.prose: Recorded, in your words: sell if net promoter score falls under 40. I could not find a published figure for it, so I cannot watch this one for you — it stays in your record, and I will say so rather than imply it is being checked.
